title: Evergreen Health Plan denial notice for MRI claim

facts.label: What this is
facts.plain_text: This is a denial notice from your health plan, not a bill. It says your plan did not pay for an MRI of your lower spine.
facts.simple_text: Your insurance said no to paying for your MRI. This is not a bill.

facts.label: Amount covered
facts.plain_text: The plan paid nothing for this service. The provider billed $2,140.00.

facts.label: Reason for denial
facts.plain_text: The claim was denied because prior authorization (approval ahead of time) was not obtained before the service. Your plan requires this for advanced imaging such as MRI.
facts.simple_text: The plan wanted approval before the MRI. It was not done.
facts.original_text: Reason code PA-04: Prior authorization was not obtained before the service.

facts.label: Appeal deadline
facts.plain_text: You or your provider may file an appeal within 180 days of the date of the notice. The deadline printed is April 13, 2027.
facts.simple_text: You must ask for an appeal by April 13, 2027.

facts.label: How to appeal
facts.plain_text: Send a written appeal with a copy of this notice to the plan's address, or use the member portal. Your provider may also request a retroactive authorization.
facts.simple_text: Mail your appeal letter or use the website. Your provider can also ask for approval after the fact.
facts.original_text: Your provider may also request a retroactive authorization.

facts.label: Service and date
facts.plain_text: The service was an MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast (72148) at Northside Imaging Center on September 3, 2026.

facts.label: Billing warning
facts.plain_text: The provider may still bill you for this service. The notice says not to ignore bills while you appeal.
facts.simple_text: You may get a bill. Do not ignore it.
facts.original_text: You may be billed by the provider for this service. Do not ignore bills while you appeal.

next_steps: Call Member Services at 1-800-555-0177 (TTY 711) with any questions.
Ask Northside Imaging Center to request a retroactive authorization.
File a written appeal with a copy of this notice before April 13, 2027.
Keep this notice and respond to any bills while you appeal.

Why your claim was denied

Your plan requires prior authorization for advanced imaging such as MRI.
Your right to appeal
You or your provider may file an appeal within 180 days of the date of this notice.
Appeal deadline: April 13, 2027
Send a written appeal with a copy of this notice to the address above, or use

Your provider may also request a retroactive authorization.
Questions? Call Member Services at 1-800-555-0177 (TTY 711).
You may also email appeals@evergreen-example.com.
You may be billed by the provider for this service. Do not ignore bills while you appeal.
